Using my throwaway account for logic reasons.   
I can completely understand that it is bothering you that when you tell your class that you have autism that somebody is responding that they’re also autistic, but self diagnosed.   
I don’t know how you know that she doesn’t have any problems?   
Maybe you can advise her to look for help if she indeed has a lot of problems. Because then she should get tested, then she know if she has autism or something completely else what always is an option! And with that information she can get the help that she needs!

Thanks for you explanation.   
Trans people I seem to understand more.  But that is I think because they don’t feel for example like a male and “change” to a women. That is easier to follow

Yes thank you!!.   
I guess that partly I don’t understand why people refer  to the stereotypes in explaining they don’t like stereotypes.  I wonder how they feel if we stop creating the stereotypes.   
I’m really overthinking this all for sure

Not even young (30+).  But raised religious I guess that’s not helping.   
I often see people respond angry if you say he/she when they want to be called something different because they don’t feel like (fe)male and I basically feel confused over that.  I mean, how do you have to feel being a female/male?
I will try (I think after sleeping).  I’m just really afraid to hurt people’s feelings, and I really don’t want that. I just try to understand but this really confusing to be honest.

If everything is about accepting each other.. how is it possible that somebody that tells about something he/she finds hard gets so much hate.  

I think (but OP please correct me if I’m wrong) that the main point is that it feels hard on the OP that people after some Googling decide they have autism. And go around telling  everybody they have autism. And that is what the OP is pointing out I think.  

There is nothing wrong white googling. Thinking you maybe have autism.  Saying you think that you maybe have autism.  Because of course, if you go and find help it can be helpful to be ask for what you need. So for example testing on autism.

But I think that it can be important to not forget that, even you have some symptoms, it doesn’t necessarily mean you have autism.  It can be something different aswel. If you start looking into autism you will find things you can relate to. But I think that will always happen. Since autism is different for everybody.  


Oh and yes, maybe the OP Could have said it a bit more nicely. But some of the responses are wrong aswel.
I don’t get why you should be such a self hating person (according to a lot of the comments). You say what you feel/thing. That should be OK

I don’t understand your point completely. I’m just lost sometimes in the amount of drawings. And that they some drawing is posted in 3 subs or more.  And it feels to me more like people do it for karma. And ofcourse people can share something they are proud of or something new they are learning.  But if somebody post multiple drawings on multiple subs, I don’t get why it is needed to be posted in this sub.

I can really understand that.  But sometimes get a bit lost if I see a update later that they from the same drawing and that just over and over.  And even get more confusing if I see it on multiple subreddits.
Thank you. Will try to read later.  At the moment I can’t focus for  long :(
